results_fixed_external_test.note: best so far; val macro/slash were still climbing at epoch 25

slash_diagnostic.interpretation: Slash is gated by chord-quality accuracy on inversion frames (richer 7th/6th chords), not by bass composition. Composing bass from the inversion head was worse than the 13-class bass head.

negative_results: Inversion-head bass composition (bass 0.694 / slash 0.077) is worse than the bass head.
Head fusion (chord * root * quality): macro 0.246 -> 0.222, ECE worsened -> not used.
Fine Slakh (61k windows) did not lift external maj6/7th quality accuracy (domain gap).
Note: the two 'slash2' variants both passed --no-augment, so --aug-level mild was inert there; a corrected mild-augmentation run was the best configuration.
next_levers: Full Slakh2100 redux (1,710 tracks) for song diversity.
Multi-scale model (local 1.6 s + global 6.4 s) to improve quality discrimination.
Label-ambiguity policy for 6th vs relative 7th chords (affects macro-F1).
External-only validation sources for checkpoint selection (in-domain Slakh val inflates selection).
Larger real-guitar corpora (Guitar-TECHS fine, IDMT dataset1-3 XML-derived labels).
Frame-level supervision (16x labels per window) for quality/inversion accuracy.

longer_schedule.variant: same config, 60 epochs (mild aug, inversion head, rare, chord-inv 2)
